四级汇总词汇 · 10英文原文

The Parade That Stopped at One Gate

在一道门前停下来的游行 · 650 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A scout group planned an annual parade to celebrate the opening of a riverside park. It wanted a horse at the front, a band behind it, and fireworks at the end. The sponsor called it glorious. Jun, a volunteer, checked the invitation. It told each participant to gather on a lawn near a narrow alley. At a rehearsal she saw a dozen children bump into a cyclist before the procession even began. A map that looked splendid on the banner gave people no place to wait.

2The scouts usually went camping in autumn. Their leader had borrowed tents, a kayak, and a wooden camel for an October display about outdoor holidays. He wanted to show how to tie a knot before an outdoor outing. Jun found one solid path from the lodge to the field. An enthusiast on a skateboard used its far end. An older gentleman came for jogging, and a nearby group practiced recreational golf. Moving every visitor onto the path would make their ordinary leisure activities harder.

3Jun proposed holding the reception near the main gate. A choir could greet people there while scouts guided small groups around the park. The sponsor worried that the event would lose its excitement. He wanted a countdown and a chance to applaud the first riders. Jun asked him to stand by the narrow alley while twelve scouts walked through it with a rolled banner. One end knocked a badge from a child's sleeve. The sponsor saw why a ceremonial entrance could become dangerous once spectators pressed forward to get a glimpse.

4Jun asked volunteers to organize a small amusement beside the entrance. An enthusiast offered a gardening demonstration. Another wanted a hunting game in the same space. A child could watch the first one without leaving the queue. The scouts put a sign on the lawn. An unexpected attraction might encourage people to wait safely until their guide arrived.

5A handler kept the horse behind a low fence. A retired gardener helped mark a route that passed a memorial and a deck. He had donated seedlings to beautify the park, and wanted the children to see what the gardening club had accomplished. At the scenic stop a family could take a photograph without drifting into the riding path. Scouts tied the signs beforehand, brought an old-fashioned camp stove for the display, and set up a second tent for visitors who needed a seat.

6An enthusiastic crowd arrived early. A puppy slipped through the gate to sniff the horse's feed. Its owner crawled under a bench to catch it. To everyone's astonishment, the handler kept the horse calm. Jun paused the procession until the way was clear. Then they heard cheers instead of impatient shouts. A participant thanked her for a more leisurely celebration. Another bought a souvenir and asked whether the park would host a reunion next June. The sponsor heard the question before he gave his greeting.

7After the last group passed, the scouts held a solemn moment to honor the people named at the memorial. A child said she wanted to celebrate by planting a flower with her grandfather. He usually came to the park for an occasional walk. This time he stayed to express his gratitude to the volunteers. The scout leader chose to keep the smaller groups for the forthcoming anniversary. Participation had been higher than he expected, and the children's joyful farewell came before dark.

8Jun took down the bold banner at the gate. The old map showed a backyard game and yearly parade on one narrow path. An organizer called the turnout the scouts' biggest accomplishment. Jun remembered something smaller. A selfless helper had given up a view of the riders to guide the first group. Wherever a crowd began to gather, that person could move it before anyone had to cheer for a rescue. Jun added his waiting place to the new map.

四级汇总词汇 · 10中文译文

在一道门前停下来的游行

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一支童子军准备办一年一度的游行，庆祝河边公园开放。他们想让马走在前面，乐队跟在后面，最后放烟花。赞助者觉得场面一定很壮观。志愿者小君先看了邀请函，上面让所有参加者到窄巷旁的草地集合。排练时，游行还没开始，十几个孩子就和骑车人撞到一起。横幅上的地图画得气派，却没留等候的位置。

2童子军一般秋天露营。队长为十月的户外假日展借来帐篷、皮划艇和木骆驼，还想在郊游前教大家打绳结。小君发现从小屋到草地只有一条硬路。远端有人玩滑板，一位年长的先生来慢跑，附近还有人练休闲高尔夫。把每位参观者都赶上这条路，其他人的日常活动就没法照常进行。

3小君提议在大门旁接待。合唱团可以在那里欢迎人群，童子军再分小组带他们逛公园。赞助者怕活动不够热闹，坚持要有倒计时，还想让大家给头一批骑手鼓掌。小君请他站在窄巷边，看十二名队员抬着卷起的横幅走过。横幅一头撞掉了孩子袖口的徽章。赞助者明白了，观众一往前挤着看，这个入场仪式就可能出危险。

4小君请志愿者在入口旁安排一点消遣。有人提议示范种花，有人想在同一处玩模拟打猎的游戏。孩子不用离开队伍就能看种花。童子军在草地立牌子。一个没想到的小节目，能让人安稳地等到向导来。

5驯马人把马留在矮栏后。一位退休园丁帮忙画路线，从纪念碑走到河上平台。他曾捐过树苗来美化公园，也想让孩子看看园艺社做成了什么。全家可以在观景处拍照，免得走到骑马的路上。队员事先系好路牌，带来老式露营炉作展示，还搭了第二顶帐篷，给需要坐下的人歇脚。

6活动当天，热情的人群早早到了。一只小狗溜过门，跑去闻马的饲料，主人只好钻到长椅下把它抱回来。大家惊讶地发现，驯马人始终让马保持安静。小君先停下队伍，等道路清理好。接着传来的是欢呼，等候的人没有催。有人感谢她把庆祝办得更从容，另一人买了纪念品，问明年六月公园还会不会组织重聚。赞助者上台问候前听见了这句话。

7最后一组走完，大家在纪念碑前肃静片刻，向碑上的人致意。一名孩子说，自己想和爷爷一起种朵花庆祝。爷爷平时偶尔来散步，这次留下来感谢志愿者。队长决定下次周年活动继续分小组走。到场的人比预想的多，孩子们高高兴兴告别时，天还没黑。

8小君摘下门口醒目的横幅。旧地图把庭院游戏和年度游行都放在一条窄路上。组织者把到场人数看成他们最大的成就。小君记住的事更小。有位帮手放弃看骑手的好位置，先带第一组走。哪里有人聚拢，他就能及时疏导，不必等到救援。小君把他的等候点补进新地图。
